speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To understand your episodes of dizziness and vertigo, please describe exactly what you feel during an episode and how long it lasts. Also, have you noticed any hearing loss, ringing in your ears, or recent head trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

I have determined the diagnosis based on your age, the sudden onset of position-dependent vertigo, and the absence of other neurological or vestibular symptoms like hearing loss. No further tests are required.
